name: Copy Check Icon
description: Icon for copy to clipboard with success feedback

variations.name: default
variations.description: Box fills then checkmark draws in when copy succeeds

props.name: size
props.description: Width and height of the icon in pixels

props.name: color
props.description: Stroke and fill color of the icon (CSS color value)

props.name: isCopied
props.description: Controls the copy success animation. Set to true when copy operation completes.
